title: Sunnydaze Modern Holiday 50-Piece Black/Silver Shatterproof Ornament Set

comparisons.notes: Sunnydaze Modern Holiday Black/Silver 50 Count, sold by Sunnydaze Decor, fulfilled by Walmart; shows arrival Fri Nov 6.
Model SME-853, 50-piece black/silver set; price shown with no out-of-stock message.

writeup: Woot has Sunnydaze's Modern Holiday 50-piece black and silver ornament set (model SME-853) new for $24.99. Walmart and Home Depot both charge $45.95 for the same set, so that's about 45% less. The shatterproof 2.25-inch balls come in 10 each of five finishes, and Woot limits it to 10 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Checker matched exactly by ASIN B0BB3CJ24G, UPC 810077854853 and model SME-853.
